svg.title: What makes a mould job Level 3
svg.desc: An isometric three-storey building with growth on more than one level, beside eight trigger cards: size, levels, HVAC, sensitive occupants, Category 3 water, old hazardous materials, structure and outside parties. Any one trigger calls for a Level 3 plan.
svg.text: What makes a mould job Level 3
Growth on more than one level
CARSI · Level 3 Mould Remediation · schematic, not to scale
